decisions: Finding, low, confirmed with high confidence: the unit run prints An update to Root inside a test was not wrapped in act from the main entry test, whose React root is never unmounted (TC-6). Developers see it in verbose unit runs; the tests still pass.
Finding, low, confirmed with high confidence: after CI builds, the browser test command builds the app a second time (TC-7). It slows every CI run; results are correct.

Finding, medium, confirmed with high confidence: package.json does not list @testing-library/dom, so with npm legacy peer deps the unit run fails with Cannot find package (TC-8). A developer with that common npm setting cannot run the unit tests.

Finding, medium, unconfirmed and read in code: the coverage status step runs the pull request's own copy of scripts/patch-coverage.mjs beside a token that can write statuses, so a same-repository pull request could post any status. It cannot run here, as it needs GitHub Actions.

Finding, low, unconfirmed and read in code: on a fork pull request the coverage status job fails because its token is read-only. The lcov file that the status rests on comes from the pull request's own code. The actions are pinned to the movable v4 tag.

Finding, low, design gap: the project's Playwright config runs only the e2e folder, so the browser coverage tests in test/coverage/browser do not run in the project's own end-to-end checks; the app has one theme, and TC-1 checks phone and desktop widths itself.

Explained away: Playwright's request fixture times out on the QA app because it does not use the environment's proxy; the browser and curl reach the app, so TC-1 reads the served page through the browser.
uncertain: The ada.report.v1 schema was not in the work folder or on this host, so the callers entry fields follow the instructions' wording; a person may need to confirm them against the contract.
Whether the coverage status token risk at ci.yml line 64 rated medium should be fixed in this Deliverable or a later one is for the QA person to decide.
The work folder held out/report.json and out/regression.json from another run, and no test/coverage folder; out/regression.json is left as it was.
